notes: The app wears a clean white-and-ink look — the warm cream is gone, and chips, dividers and fills were retuned so nothing washes out on the white pages
Pickup codes: your hold now shows a 6-character code — show it at the counter and the store pulls up your exact hold in one tap
Sellers: collect a hold by typing the customer's code and record the sale in the same action
Store goodwill: a store can give your hold another 24 hours with a reason — see every one under My Pickup Reservations
Fixed: new-device verification now actually works — the code email sends a code, not a link
Fixed: the confirm button in your sign-up email now returns you to the app and finishes setting up your profile
Fixed: tapping Log In with no internet connection no longer locks you out of your account
Clearer messages when an email cannot be delivered, instead of blaming you for a typo
